name: Fuso Battleship
description: The No. 1 Fuso-class battleship of the Japanese Navy, it is the first super crossbow-class battleship designed independently by Japan. It was built at the Wuxian Naval Shipyard. When completed, it was the warship with the largest displacement, armament, and ship type in the world at that time. It entered service on November 18, 1915. The ship is 205 meters long, 28.65 meters wide, has a full load displacement of 38,536 tons, and a speed of 24.7 knots. It is equipped with 12 twin 356 mm main guns, 16 152 mm secondary guns and other firepower equipment. During the Battle of Leyte Gulf in 1944, the Fuso was attacked by the U.S. Navy during the battle and sank on October 25.
